deterministic_reachability.correction_reason: The originally requested convex probability mixture is an absorbing deterministic latch whenever persistence exceeds 0.5. The log-odds prior preserves neutral-output stickiness and makes both transitions learnable.

stochastic_vs_deterministic_capability_g.definition: stochastic share minus deterministic deployment share

credit_assignment.contact_event_definition: reward > 5 and next touch age confirms contact
credit_assignment.failed_cohort_definition: no rewarded contact and at least 1430 ticks; short collection-cut segments excluded
credit_assignment.successful_cohort_definition: first visible rewarded contact in a trajectory segment whose initial self-touch age is reset/saturated
